role.description: The role of the tool call result in the conversation.

toolCallId.description: The ID of the tool call.

name.description: The name of the tool that returned the result.

result.description: The result of the tool call in JSON format.

time.description: The timestamp when the message was sent.

secondsFromStart.description: The number of seconds from the start of the conversation.

metadata.description: The metadata for the tool call result.

warnings.description:
Warnings raised for this tool call result, e.g. when the response is
larger than recommended for voice AI context windows.
